# Critical PHP Security Release: What It Means for Azure App Service

## What Changed

PHP on App Service Windows: The built-in PHP runtimes on App Service for Windows are end-of-life (EOL). No security patch for these runtimes is currently planned. Move to App Service on Linux if possible. Update and test your app on a supported PHP version to receive the patched built-in PHP runtime. If you must remain on Windows, bring your own PHP runtime. Follow How to use a Custom PHP runtime for App Service Windows and use a supported PHP version that includes the security fixes. You are responsible for deploying, configuring, and maintaining that runtime, including applying future security patches. Azure Stack Hub: This Windows guidance also applies to PHP apps running on Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub.

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This may change the workload security posture or required controls.
